**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refuse Tab while resizing a track**

When the user presses Tab while holding a track-width or track-height resize handle, `begin_track_resize` has focused `self.focus` and set `track_layout.drag`, but this guard does not test `track_resize_active()`. The event therefore switches modes, and the next render calls `reconcile_track_resize`, which restores the previous size because a resize is invalid outside Arrangement. This both discards the in-progress resize and changes workspaces; reject Tab while that drag is active.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L295-L299](https://github.com/PORTALSURFER/hex/blob/d035b55f678c2bf782f6a9754f1b9867337673d6/AGENTS.md#L295-L299)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restore workspace focus after toolbar switches**

When an Arrangement track header owns focus and the user clicks the Console toolbar button, `set_mode` removes that header from the rendered tree but the button callback never focuses `self.focus`. Subsequent key events fall back to the root while both eligibility checks here are false (`self.focus` is not focused and `track_header_focused` rejects Session mode), so Tab cannot return to Arrange. Route toolbar switches through the same focus handoff as `workspace_tab`.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block Tab while a clip-paint gesture is active**

When the user holds the second click of a double-click-and-drag clip-paint gesture and presses Tab before releasing, `begin_clip_paint` has focused the workspace, but this guard does not check `clip_paint_gesture`. The handler therefore switches to Console while the Arrangement pointer owner is active, discarding the in-progress paint and potentially retaining stale gesture state until another pointer event cancels it; refuse the switch just as for the other active drags.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block Tab while a ruler scrub is active**

When the user holds a left-button ruler scrub and presses Tab, `begin_scrub` has focused the workspace, but this guard does not check the scrub gesture. The bubbling handler therefore enters Console, and the next `tick_scrub` cancels the remaining targets because the mode is no longer Arrangement, aborting the in-progress drag before its release can finish it; refuse Tab until the scrub ends, as for the other Arrangement pointer owners.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block Tab while an arrangement pan is active**

While the editor retains focus, holding the middle button over the timeline sets `arrangement_pan`, but this refusal list never checks it. Pressing Tab therefore reaches `set_mode`, whose mode-change path calls `cancel_arrangement_pan()`, switching to Console and discarding the in-progress pan before mouse release; guard this pointer owner like the other active gestures.
